origin.description: Evaluate f(c(x, y)) on a linspace grid and draw the contour.
origin.usage: ezcontour(fn, xlim=c(-pi, pi), ylim=c(-pi, pi), n=60, filled=FALSE, col=None)
origin.details: x^2 + y^2 on a 4 by 4 grid. R time is that matrix, not a graphics device.
origin.value: Evaluate f(c(x, y)) on a linspace grid and draw the contour.
origin.example: { xx <- linspace(0, 1, 4); yy <- linspace(0, 1, 4); F <- matrix(NA, 4, 4); for (i in 1:4) for (j in 1:4) F[i,j] <- xx[i]^2 + yy[j]^2; pdf(file.path(tempdir(),"p.pdf")); ezcontour(function(v) v[1]^2+v[2]^2, c(0,1), c(0,1), n=4); dev.off(); as.numeric(F) }
